justification: The assessment identifies a genuine eigenspace-sign error, distinct from the ground truth’s failure of adjoint injectivity. Using the stated Bloch–Kato identity, W=overline(W) and F^0=0 make the left side dim W^{c=1}, while the printed right side is dim W^{c=-1}. For W=Q_p(3)^2 ⊕ χQ_p(3), with χ an odd quadratic character, these dimensions are 1 and 2, giving the false inequality 1≥2. The dimension identity agrees with [Lemma 6.3](https://arxiv.org/html/1903.05032v4#S6.SS2.SSS1).
